review_tasks.task: Trace 7A8 signal-input grid G4 (socket pin 6) to the aerial transformer, RF tuning gang, and loop/mains-isolation path.
review_tasks.pinout_basis: Sylvania identifies Grid 4 as the signal input; its B8B pinout maps G4 to socket pin 6. Philco receiver wiring still requires direct schematic tracing.
review_tasks.review_result: The V1:6 signal-input branch now includes the #6 series condenser/choke trap to the explicit loop-mode chassis ground. The broader converter route, #4 oscillator gang, 7A8 pin crosswalks and mains-isolation relationship remain open.

review_tasks.review_result: The named socket pin has a reviewed receiver net; this does not close the rest of the subsystem.

heater_check.status: Operating reference 6.3 V at 0.15 A for each 7-series Loktal; old nomenclature used nominal 7.0 V. Pure resistor calculation ignores rectifier loading, lamp branch and specific dropper wiring; 87.3 ohms is not a factory resistor claim.

required_factory_net_status: PINOUT VALIDATION DOES NOT CERTIFY FACTORY WIRING. Proposed terminal trace tasks are not electrical edges and do not enter SPICE.
source_note: Tube references document electrode identity; Philco 1941 schematic remains the authority for receiver-specific connectivity. v0.45 completes the wired 50L6 screen pin crosswalk (V4:4) and corrects the older 7A8/7B7 screen-to-B+ glyph claims; v0.47 completes factory component #6 from the signal-input conductor through its series condenser/choke to loop-mode chassis ground. The remaining 7A8 oscillator and pin crosswalk work remains open.
